name: Prezzario Regionale — Regional Price List Compliance
description: Validates BOQ items and unit rates against the prezzario regionale (regional price list) framework used across Italian regions. Checks that each voce (item) references a valid prezzario code, that unit rates do not exceed the regional benchmark without justification (analisi prezzi), that measurement units match the prezzario definition, and that the correct regional edition year is referenced.
regulator: Regioni (regional governments) / DEI (Tipografia del Genio Civile)
